units.source_text: 源氏又说：“无论何种学问，用心钻研起来，便可知道任何才艺都无止境。

en.t: Genji said again, “Whatever the field of study, if one applies oneself to it earnestly, one comes to know that there is no limit to any art or accomplishment.

units.source_text: 能够永不自满，锐意进取，实乃难得之事。

en.t: To remain forever unsatisfied and press forward with determination is truly a rare thing.

units.source_text: 老实说，精通博学之人，在今世几同凤毛麟角。

en.t: To be honest, people of deep mastery and broad learning are almost as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns in this age.

units.source_text: 能够正确地学得某种学问之一端，其人就此满足了。

en.t: When someone manages to learn even one part of a discipline correctly, he is satisfied with that much.

units.source_text: 惟七弦琴一道，学理非常奥妙，不可草率染指。

en.t: But the way of the seven-stringed qin is extraordinarily subtle in its principles, and one must not take it up carelessly.

units.source_text: 昔时精通古法之人，操起琴来，可以动天地，泣鬼神。

en.t: In ancient times, those who mastered the old methods could move heaven and earth and make spirits weep when they played the qin.

units.source_text: 种种音调，各有妙用：或能转悲伤为喜悦；或能变贫贱为富贵，而获得财宝。

en.t: The various modes each have their own wondrous effects: some can turn sorrow into joy, while others can transform poverty and lowliness into wealth and honor, bringing treasure as well.

units.source_text: 世间可信之事例甚多。

en.t: There are many believable examples of this in the world.

units.source_text: 在我国，此琴尚未传入之前，曾有深通音乐之人，多年远客他邦，奋不顾身，潜心学习，尚且难于学成。

en.t: Before this qin had been brought to our country, even people deeply versed in music spent many years abroad, devoting themselves to study without regard for their own safety, and still found it hard to master.

units.source_text: 实因此琴又能当面使日月星辰移动，使盛夏降霜飞雪，使风云雷霆轰动大地，古昔之世，确有其例。

en.t: Indeed, because this qin could make the sun, moon, and stars move before one’s eyes, bring frost and falling snow in the height of summer, and make wind, clouds, thunder, and lightning shake the earth, there truly were such examples in ancient times.

units.source_text: 琴之为物，如此灵妙无极，故能全般学得之人，实甚少有。

en.t: The qin is so spiritually wondrous and boundless that those who can learn it completely are truly very few.

units.source_text: 都因末世人心不古，故能传承当时妙法之一端者，亦甚难得。

en.t: Because in these latter days people’s hearts are no longer what they were in ancient times, even someone able to transmit one part of those wondrous old methods is very hard to find.

units.source_text: 但亦另有原因：大约由于此乐器自古能使鬼神倾听而感动，故学得似通非通之人，生涯往往不幸。

en.t: But there is another reason as well: since this instrument has from ancient times been able to make spirits listen and be moved, those who learn it only half well often have unhappy lives.

units.source_text: 此后便有人厌恶此乐器，倡言‘弹琴者遭殃’。

en.t: After that, some people came to detest the instrument and began saying, ‘Those who play the qin meet with disaster.’

units.source_text: 世人为免烦恼，大都不肯学习，因此今世几乎无人能传此道，真乃大可惋惜之事！

en.t: People in the world mostly refuse to learn it in order to avoid trouble, and so in this age there is almost no one who can transmit the way. It is truly a matter for deep regret!

units.source_text: 试问除琴以外，有何乐器可作调整音律之标准？

en.t: Tell me, apart from the qin, what instrument could serve as the standard for setting musical pitch?

units.source_text: 当然，在此万事日渐衰微之世间，独自树立大志，抛却妻子，远访中国、高丽等异域，固将被世人视为狂徒。

en.t: Of course, in this world where everything grows weaker day by day, a man who alone forms a great ambition, abandons his wife and children, and travels far to foreign lands such as China or Goryeo would certainly be regarded by others as a madman.

units.source_text: 然而不必如此，但望学得精通此道之由绪，有何不可！

en.t: Yet there is no need to go so far; what could be wrong with merely wishing to learn the lineage by which this way may be mastered?

units.source_text: 要精通一调，尚且有无穷困难，何况调子甚多，高深之乐曲不计其数。

en.t: To master even a single mode already involves endless difficulties, and all the more so when there are so many modes and countless profound pieces.

units.source_text: 故我当年专心学琴之时，曾广泛收罗日本固有及外国传来之乐谱，悉心钻研。

en.t: Therefore, when I devoted myself to studying the qin in those years, I widely gathered both Japan’s own scores and scores transmitted from abroad, and studied them with all my heart.

units.source_text: 后来无师可从，犹自热心学习。

en.t: Later, when there was no teacher left for me to follow, I still continued to study eagerly on my own.

units.source_text: 然而还是赶不上古人。

en.t: And yet I still could not match the people of old.

units.source_text: 何况自今以后，我又无有可传之子孙，思之不胜怅惘。”

en.t: All the more so because from now on I have no descendants to whom I can pass it on. When I think of this, I am overcome with melancholy.”

units.source_text: 夕雾听了这话，深感惋惜，又觉可耻。

en.t: Yugiri heard these words and felt deep regret, as well as a sense of shame.

units.source_text: 源氏又说：“明石女御所生皇子之中，倘有乐才符我所望的人成长起来，而此时我尚长生在世，我必将我之技法多少传授与他。

en.t: Genji said again, “If among the princes born to the Akashi Consort there should grow up someone with the musical talent I hope for, and if I am still alive then, I will surely pass on at least some of my techniques to him.

units.source_text: 看来二皇子将来是富有音乐才能的。”

en.t: It seems that the Second Prince will be richly gifted in music in the future.”

units.source_text: 二皇子的外祖母明石夫人听了这话，觉得自己面目光彩，流下欢喜的眼泪来。

en.t: Lady Akashi, the Second Prince’s maternal grandmother, heard these words, felt her own honor shine, and shed tears of joy.
